headline: Shell and Partners Approve LNG Canada Phase 2 Expansion to 28 MTPA
summary: Shell, Petronas, PetroChina, Mitsubishi, and Kogas approved the final investment decision for LNG Canada Phase 2. The expansion doubles the facility's export capacity to 28 million tons per annum to supply Asian energy markets.
why: Liquefied natural gas infrastructure requires billions in long-term capital and dictates global fuel trade flows, especially from North America to Asian utilities.

impacts.name: Global Liquefied Natural Gas
impacts.why: Sanctioning Phase 2 locks in significant long-term export volumes from Western Canada to Asia.
